authority.source_of_truth: Pinned Lean/Mathlib source, stable theorem identifiers, checked proof terms, and reviewed theorem metadata.
authority.task_authority: Reviewed formalization issues linked to exact source claims and proof obligations.
authority.acceptance_authority: Lean kernel verification plus repository conformance checks; empirical applicability remains a separate reviewed claim.
authority.deployment_authority: No production deployment authority; downstream systems separately decide operational use.

data.retention: Proofs, theorem identifiers, failed attempts, source links, and supersession history remain version controlled.
data.deletion: Incorrect formalizations are deprecated or superseded; prior proof history is not silently erased.
data.secret_storage: No credentials or private corpora are stored in the theorem repository.

change_control.rollback_or_revocation: Theorems and source mappings are deprecated, superseded, or retracted with retained history.

stabilization.summary: Add a machine-readable manifest linking each theorem to the exact source claim, assumptions, DSL evidence, and applicability statement.
Produce clean pinned proof builds and retained release attestations.
Retain mutation and adversarial proof checks as evidence instead of one-off CI diagnostics.
